speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a painful, ulcerative skin lesion on your leg; please describe exactly how it started, its appearance, and any associated symptoms like fever or red streaks. Additionally, have you recently traveled to any endemic areas or been exposed to insects or animals?

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old woman. The patient reports a skin lesion on her right leg that has been present for 1 month. The lesion began as a small red spot and has increased in size. She recalls an ant bite at the site before the lesion developed. She has a history of anterior uveitis treated with corticosteroids 8 months ago, as well as Crohn's disease, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypertension.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (secondary to ant bite) in a patient with significant immunosuppression (Crohn's disease, Type 2 Diabetes, and prior corticosteroid use).
